name: Calculate campaign performance metrics
covers: CTR CPC CPM CPA and ROAS calculations
description: Verifies campaign inputs produce the expected performance metrics.
steps: Enter spend 100, impressions 10000, clicks 500, conversions 10 and revenue 400
expected: CTR is 5.00%, CPC is $0.20, CPM is $10.00, CPA is $10.00 and ROAS is 4.00x.

name: Allocate a monthly media budget
description: Verifies platform allocations update from budget and percentage inputs.
steps: Set Meta to 60%, Google to 30% and TikTok to 10%
expected: Meta allocation is $1,800, Google is $900, TikTok is $300, and the budget is fully allocated.

name: Build a campaign UTM link
description: Verifies UTM inputs produce a correctly parameterized campaign URL.
steps: Set source to newsletter and campaign to winter_launch
Review the generated URL and use Copy URL
expected: The generated URL contains utm_source=newsletter and utm_campaign=winter_launch, with visible copy confirmation.

name: Handle empty data on mobile
description: Verifies zero inputs do not produce invalid numeric output and the mobile workflow remains usable.
steps: Set all numeric inputs to zero
expected: Metrics display zero values without NaN or Infinity, and the analyzer prompts for campaign data.
